title: Circularly polarized luminescence: an easy path from molecules to supramolecular systems and beyond
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6CS00339G, Tutorial Review
Francesco Bertocchi, Davide Giavazzi, Shahana Nizar, D. K. Andrea Phan Huu, Lorenzo Savi, Francesca Terenziani, Cristina Sissa, Anna Painelli
This tutorial introduces circularly polarized luminescence of organic materials. It covers basic concepts, experimental determination, an overview of models, and the challenges of circularly polarized electroluminescence.
